name: hyperswitch
description: Agent skills for running Hyperswitch locally, calling its payments API end to end, and adding new payment processor connectors.

interface.longDescription: Skills for Hyperswitch, the open-source composable payments platform. Covers running it locally with the one-click setup script or Docker Compose (profiles, health checks, logs, admin key); calling the v1 REST API with the right admin and merchant authentication to create merchant accounts, API keys and connector accounts, then create, confirm, capture and refund payments; and contributing a new connector with scripts/add_connector.sh, OpenAPI-generated types, transformers, the ConnectorCommon and ConnectorIntegration traits, PII handling and tests.
defaultPrompt: Spin up Hyperswitch locally and check it is healthy
Create a test merchant, connector and card payment against my local Hyperswitch
Scaffold a new connector for my payment processor
